shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
circular/disc motif (rosettes in A, incised ring in B)
parallel incised lines suggesting hair, fringe or drapery
justification: Both are weathered grey stone worked in shallow relief and both include prominent circular/disc elements together with dense sets of parallel incised lines reading as hair or fringed cloth. But A is a flat architectural panel with a horizontal band of rosettes framing a procession of naturalistic profile figures, whereas B is a free-standing monolithic block whose sparse, abstract, low-contrast markings follow the curved body of the stone with no register system or figural scene at all.
